# Screen Rant
> Screen Rant is an entertainment publication covering breaking news, reviews, features, trailers, and explainers for movies, TV, comics, gaming, and pop culture.

Founded in 2003, Screen Rant publishes daily coverage of major franchises, streaming releases, box office developments, casting news, and in-depth entertainment analysis across film, television, comics, anime, and games.

## Core Coverage
- [Movies](https://screenrant.com/category/movies/): News, reviews, trailers, features, and explainers focused on films and theatrical releases.
- [TV](https://screenrant.com/category/tv/): Television news, episode analysis, streaming coverage, and series features.
- [Comics](https://screenrant.com/category/comics/): Comic book news, character analysis, creator coverage, and franchise updates.
- [Gaming](https://screenrant.com/category/gaming/): Video game news, guides, features, and commentary on major releases.
- [Anime](https://screenrant.com/category/anime/): Anime news, recommendations, rankings, and franchise explainers.
- [Reality TV](https://screenrant.com/category/reality-tv/): Coverage of reality series, cast updates, recaps, and franchise news.
- [Lists](https://screenrant.com/category/lists/): Ranked features and list-based entertainment coverage across major topics.

## Movie Coverage
- [Movie News](https://screenrant.com/category/movie-news/): Breaking film industry news, casting updates, release changes, and production developments.
- [Movie Reviews](https://screenrant.com/category/movie-reviews/): Critical reviews of new theatrical and streaming movie releases.
- [Movie Trailers](https://screenrant.com/category/movie-trailers/): New trailer debuts and analysis for upcoming films.
- [Movie Features](https://screenrant.com/category/movie-features/): In-depth articles exploring characters, franchises, endings, and production details.
- [Box Office](https://screenrant.com/tag/box-office/): Reporting and analysis on theatrical performance and revenue milestones.
- [Marvel Movies](https://screenrant.com/tag/marvel/): Coverage of Marvel films, MCU developments, and related franchise news.
- [DC Movies](https://screenrant.com/tag/dc/): News and features on DC films, characters, and cinematic universe projects.

## TV Coverage
- [TV News](https://screenrant.com/category/tv-news/): Breaking television news, renewals, cancellations, and casting announcements.
- [TV Reviews](https://screenrant.com/category/tv-reviews/): Reviews of current series, premieres, finales, and streaming originals.
- [TV Features](https://screenrant.com/category/tv-features/): Analysis of episodes, characters, timelines, and franchise connections.
- [Streaming](https://screenrant.com/tag/streaming/): Coverage of streaming platforms, release strategies, and digital premieres.
- [Netflix](https://screenrant.com/tag/netflix/): News and features about Netflix originals and licensed programming.
- [Disney+](https://screenrant.com/tag/disney-plus/): Coverage of Disney+ series, films, and franchise releases.
- [HBO](https://screenrant.com/tag/hbo/): News and analysis related to HBO and Max programming.

## Comics & Superheroes
- [Marvel Comics](https://screenrant.com/tag/marvel-comics/): Comic-focused Marvel coverage including characters, storylines, and creator news.
- [DC Comics](https://screenrant.com/tag/dc-comics/): DC comic book news, continuity explainers, and character-focused features.
- [Batman](https://screenrant.com/tag/batman/): Articles about Batman stories, adaptations, villains, and comic developments.
- [Superman](https://screenrant.com/tag/superman/): Coverage of Superman comics, films, TV appearances, and franchise analysis.
- [Spider-Man](https://screenrant.com/tag/spider-man/): News and features on Spider-Man comics, movies, and multiverse stories.
- [X-Men](https://screenrant.com/tag/x-men/): X-Men franchise coverage spanning comics, animation, and film adaptations.

## Gaming
- [Gaming News](https://screenrant.com/category/gaming-news/): Breaking news on game announcements, updates, and industry developments.
- [Game Features](https://screenrant.com/category/game-features/): Analysis of mechanics, lore, design choices, and franchise trends.
- [Game Reviews](https://screenrant.com/category/game-reviews/): Reviews of new video game releases across platforms.
- [Game Guides](https://screenrant.com/category/game-guides/): Strategy, walkthroughs, tips, and progression help for popular games.
- [RPGs](https://screenrant.com/tag/rpg/): Coverage of role-playing games, builds, systems, and major releases.
- [Nintendo](https://screenrant.com/tag/nintendo/): News and features on Nintendo games, hardware, and franchises.
- [PlayStation](https://screenrant.com/tag/playstation/): Coverage of PlayStation releases, exclusives, and platform updates.

## Anime & Genre Entertainment
- [Anime News](https://screenrant.com/category/anime-news/): Breaking anime announcements, release updates, and adaptation coverage.
- [Anime Features](https://screenrant.com/category/anime-features/): Franchise explainers, rankings, and character-focused anime articles.
- [Star Wars](https://screenrant.com/tag/star-wars/): News and analysis on Star Wars films, series, and expanded universe topics.
- [Star Trek](https://screenrant.com/tag/star-trek/): Coverage of Star Trek shows, films, canon, and character discussions.
- [Harry Potter](https://screenrant.com/tag/harry-potter/): Features and news on Wizarding World stories and adaptations.
- [Lord of the Rings](https://screenrant.com/tag/lord-of-the-rings/): Articles on Tolkien adaptations, lore, and franchise developments.

## Reality TV & Lifestyle Entertainment
- [Reality TV News](https://screenrant.com/category/reality-tv-news/): Breaking updates on reality franchises, cast members, and season developments.
- [Reality TV Features](https://screenrant.com/category/reality-tv-features/): Analysis, recaps, and cast-focused features on unscripted television.
- [90 Day Fiancé](https://screenrant.com/tag/90-day-fiance/): Franchise coverage including cast updates, episodes, and spinoff news.
- [The Bachelor](https://screenrant.com/tag/the-bachelor/): News and commentary on Bachelor Nation shows and contestants.
- [Sister Wives](https://screenrant.com/tag/sister-wives/): Coverage of the Brown family, episodes, and franchise developments.
- [Keeping Up With The Kardashians](https://screenrant.com/tag/keeping-up-with-the-kardashians/): Articles on the Kardashian family and related reality programming.

## Reviews & Recommendations
- [Reviews](https://screenrant.com/category/reviews/): Central hub for Screen Rant reviews across movies, TV, and games.
- [Best On Netflix](https://screenrant.com/tag/netflix/): Recommendations and features highlighting notable Netflix titles.
- [Best On Disney+](https://screenrant.com/tag/disney-plus/): Viewing suggestions and franchise-focused Disney+ coverage.
- [Ending Explained](https://screenrant.com/tag/ending-explained/): Articles unpacking endings, twists, and post-credit implications.
- [Explainers](https://screenrant.com/tag/explainer/): Context pieces clarifying lore, timelines, and story details.
- [Rankings](https://screenrant.com/category/lists/): Ranked lists comparing characters, episodes, films, and franchises.
